{{Quote|The mining charges didn't go off. The countdown's been averted. We heard blaster fire, Commander. Are you injured?''"<br />"''No. I was never the target.|A clone officer and the clone commander after the end of the battle on Viidaav|<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides (comic)" />}}
This '''clone trooper commander''' was an [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commando]] who fought in the [[Battle of Viidaav]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During the battle, the [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] was sent to disable a bomb which was planted by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] forces on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. The bomb was powerful enough to destroy the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. After fighting through [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] inside the bunker which contained the bomb, he [[Death/Legends|killed]] a [[Unidentified Viidaav commander|Viidaav commander]] that he encountered in the control room after a brief stand-off. Once the smoke cleared, the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] realized that the [[Viidaav (species)|Viidaav]] was actually aiming for the control panel that controlled the bomb's detonation sequence, and having destroyed it saved the planet.<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides (comic)" />

==Behind the scenes==
This clone trooper commander first appeared in the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] [[Heroes on Both Sides (comic story)|Heroes on Both Sides]].
